'''Flummot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] fence that operated out of [[Gandanta Station]]. Flummot hired some muscle as protection while he dealt with [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] agents who had acquired artwork from the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], though was injured when the deal was interrupted. He had a chance cube fitted with a homing beacon.<ref name="FH">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Flummot appeared in the role-playing sourcebook ''[[Far Horizons]]'' released in [[2014]] and developed by [[Sam Stewart]].<ref name="FH">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref>
